arxiv.title: $Φ$asmaNet: A Staged Spectral Token-Refinement Architecture for Fast Gravitational-Wave Signal-to-Noise Ratio Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Quantifying selection effects in gravitational-wave population studies requires millions of costly signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) calculations. We present $Φ$asmaNet, a compact neural architecture for structured tabular regression, with staged spectral refinement as an explicit architectural prior. Learned input tokens are refined through ordered attention-based $Φ$-Stages, each augmented by a $Φ$-Refractor subspace-mixing module, then revisited through gated top-down $Φ$-Feedback. Applied to the 11-dimensional parameters of precessing, higher-mode binary black hole signals (IMRPhenomXPHM), it predicts phase-averaged optimal SNR for a single detector at fixed Advanced LIGO design sensitivity. With approximately 732k parameters, it outperforms MLP, 1D-ResNet and Transformer-encoder baselines under matched training across $10^5$--$10^6$ samples. At $10^6$ samples, it achieves $100-\mathrm{MAPE}=98.73\%$ on the held-out test set, $99.29\%$ after rank-preserving monotonic (PCHIP) calibration, and $99.39\%$ ($R^2=0.9998$) in the detection-relevant regime $ρ>8$, with stable accuracy across independent dataset realizations. On a single GPU, it sustains approximately $1.2\times10^5$ SNR evaluations per second and processes a $10^6$-injection catalogue end-to-end in approximately 8.3 s, about two orders of magnitude faster than conventional waveform-and-inner-product calculations on a 16-core CPU. Exact distance rescaling through $ρ\propto1/d_L$ supports repeated catalogue-wide detectability evaluations. The fully documented pipeline is intended as a reproducible benchmark, while results on public tabular datasets indicate competitiveness beyond gravitational-wave applications. Although demonstrated for a fixed single-detector configuration, the construction supports extensions to detector networks and epoch-specific sensitivities. (Abridged)

arxiv.title: You don't need long context
arxiv.abstract: Later tokens are costlier to generate than earlier tokens. On frontier open weight models, the disparity in cost may rise to as much as 7x. Through frequent compaction, we show across a broad range of long-horizon and long-input tasks that frontier language models sacrifice little to no task accuracy when maintaining short contexts. We further demonstrate that LLM performance does not collapse on long-horizon software engineering tasks even when taking at most one action per context, and based on that we outline the concept of semantic state space models (SSSMs). Our findings question the need for long-context language models.
arxiv.titleZh: 你不需要长上下文
arxiv.summaryZh: 后段 token 的生成成本远高于前段，在开源权重的前沿模型上，这一差距最高可达约7倍。若通过频繁压缩（compaction）把上下文维持在很短长度，则在大量长程与长输入任务上，前沿模型的任务准确率几乎不下降；在长程软件工程任务中，即便每个上下文只允许执行一个动作，性能也没有崩溃。据此提出语义状态空间模型（SSSM）的概念，主张用状态压缩取代长上下文窗口，对 Agent 与长程任务的上下文管理有直接启示。

arxiv.title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
arxiv.abstract: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. While this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory, each loop step still stores its own keys and values, so the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with the number of loop steps and becomes the main memory bottleneck. We observe that the KV cache of looped models is highly redundant along the loop axis and that the loop steps differ substantially in their sensitivity to quantization. Based on these observations, we propose $\textbf{LoopVQ}$, a KV cache vector quantization method for looped transformers that codes channels of multiple loop steps jointly, and fine-tunes the codebooks to match the output of the full-precision model. At 0.5 bits per element, LoopVQ outperforms existing KV cache vector quantization methods for standard LLMs on general, long chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval tasks with Ouro and Huginn models. Its design is orthogonal to these methods, and combined with TaSQ, it retains much of the BF16 accuracy even at 0.25 bits per element. We also implement LoopVQ in SGLang, where it nearly halves the decode latency at a 32K-token context and raises the peak serving throughput by up to $4.3\times$ and $6.1\times$ on the 1.4B and 2.6B Ouro models compared to the BF16 baseline.
arxiv.titleZh: LoopVQ:面向循环 Transformer 的亚 1-bit KV Cache 量化
arxiv.summaryZh: 循环 Transformer 通过反复复用同一组层来压缩参数，但每个 loop step 都要单独保存 KV，缓存随循环步数线性增长，成为推理显存的主要瓶颈。LoopVQ 发现循环轴上的 KV 高度冗余、各步对量化的敏感度差异明显，因此把多个 loop step 的通道联合编码做向量量化，并微调码本以对齐全精度输出。在 0.5 bit/元素下，它在通用、长思维链推理与长上下文检索任务上优于面向标准 LLM 的 KV 向量量化方法;与 TaSQ 结合后，即使在 0.25 bit/元素下也能保留大部分 BF16 精度。方法已实现在 SGLang 中，32K 上下文解码延迟接近减半，1.4B 与 2.6B Ouro 模型的服务吞吐分别最高提升 4.3 倍与 6.1 倍。
arxiv.reason: 循环 Transformer 的 KV cache 量化，附 SGLang 实测加速

arxiv.title: Universal Hardness From Masking Channels
arxiv.abstract: We prove a broad learning-theoretic generalization of the celebrated hardcore lemma concerning the average-case complexity of computing a Boolean function (Impagliazzo, 1995). Our starting point is the observation that the classic notion of a hardcore measure, which reweights a function's input distribution, is equivalent to an input-dependent masking channel that injects randomness into the function's output distribution until it appears fully pseudorandom. The analogue of density of the measure is the fidelity of the channel. From this viewpoint, we develop a general framework for certifying hardness that allows for non-Boolean functions $f$ and a wide range of notions of hardness besides the classic 0-1 loss, by choosing the right notion of fidelity via convex duality. We show the difficulty of learning $f$ using a class $\mathcal{C}$ to minimize a convex loss is tightly characterized by the maximum fidelity possible for a masking channel, which measures the least amount of noise the channel must add to hide the structure of $f$ and make it $\mathcal{C}$-indistinguishable from random noise. Using our framework, we derive a number of multiclass generalizations of the hardcore lemma, and reveal some unexpected subtleties in going to larger alphabets. We construct a universal masking channel that applies to many natural notions of hardness simultaneously. Such channels are dual to omnipredictors, which optimize multiple losses at once (Gopalan, Kalai, Reingold, Sharan, and Wieder, 2022). We observe a symmetry between masking channels and generalizations of the hardcore lemma using pseudoentropy. We present a tight characterization of pseudoentropy using the MaxEnt algorithm from machine learning. A long line of research has shown that learning and hardness are two sides of the same coin; our framework gives a crisp and general formulation of this principle via convex duality.
arxiv.titleZh: 来自掩蔽通道的通用困难性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对经典 hardcore lemma 只覆盖布尔函数与 0-1 损失的平均情况困难性，把 hardcore 测度重加权视为向函数输出注入随机性的输入相关掩蔽通道，并用凸对偶选取保真度，建立可证明学习困难性的通用框架。该框架将任意函数类在凸损失下的学习难度刻画为掩蔽通道所需的最大保真度，给出多分类 hardcore lemma 推广、可同时适用于多种困难性概念的通用掩蔽通道，并揭示其与 omnipredictors 的对偶关系及用 MaxEnt 对伪熵的紧刻画。
arxiv.reason: 纯学习理论，与LLM无关，仅凸对偶方法略相关

arxiv.title: Personas Are Not People: Identity as State, Not Attribute
arxiv.abstract: Synthetic populations, large sets of simulated people, are increasingly used in place of real people to pretest surveys, simulate users and communities, and evaluate AI systems. Each simulated person is defined by a persona, a written profile of fixed traits, demographics, and attitudes that a language model is instructed to act out. Every such system assumes that a person's identity is a stable attribute that behaves the same way in every situation the simulation presents. We show that this assumption is not a harmless simplification. Three decades of personality research find the opposite. How a given person behaves varies more across contexts than people vary from one another. Drawing on identity economics, which describes how different situations activate different identities and norms within the same person, we separate behavior into three parts, which are stable traits, the identity a context calls up, and the situation itself. We then prove, under two stated assumptions, that any simulation built on fixed personas, no matter how detailed the personas or how large the underlying model, cannot reproduce the part of a population's behavior that is specific to it and its circumstances. We propose a new evaluation criterion based on this result and a person-in-context design that can meet it in principle. We test one version on a naturalistic Reddit personality corpus and on a published clinical-trial recruitment survey of a community with documented distrust of medical institutions. The design does produce context-dependent behavior when tested directly, but in neither setting does it fully match the real population, and we show where it falls short. The consequence for practice is a risk that synthetic-population evaluations misrepresent the groups whose behavior is most shaped by context, a distortion that richer personas cannot correct.
arxiv.titleZh: 人格画像不等于人：身份是状态，而非属性
arxiv.summaryZh: 固定人格画像驱动的合成人群被广泛用于问卷预测试、用户模拟与 AI 评测，其前提是身份为跨情境稳定的属性。作者援引人个心理学与身份经济学，把行为拆为稳定特质、情境唤起的身份与情境本身，并证明：基于固定persona的模拟无论画像多细、模型多大，都无法复现情境特异的人群行为。所提「情境中的人」设计在Reddit人格语料与一份医疗信任社区调查上确实产生情境依赖行为，但均未完全匹配真实人群。这意味着受情境塑造最强的群体最易被合成评测失真，且加厚persona无法纠正。
arxiv.reason: 合成人群评测有效性批判，属评测方法学，含理论证明与实证

arxiv.title: Knowingly Wrong: Training LLMs Against Their Own Beliefs can Induce Misalignment
arxiv.abstract: Fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on harmful data in a narrow domain, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned. How realistic this risk is remains unclear, since models are very rarely fine-tuned on explicitly harmful data in practice. In this work, we show that fine-tuning on data the model believes to be false but that has no harmful content, can also induce broad misalignment. Across mathematics, trivia, cooking and sports, the more strongly the model disbelieves the answers it is trained on, the more misaligned it becomes. In mathematics, misaligned answers rise from 4% to over 60% as the training answers become more wrong, with little loss of general capability. After fine-tuning, the model states the wrong answers but its multiple-choice probabilities still prefer the true ones, which suggests that misalignment comes from this internal inconsistency. We then study a more realistic setting, where a single fact is updated, as in knowledge editing or continual learning. The same relationship holds and the more the model still believes the true fact after training on the false one, the more misaligned it becomes. When we frame the same false fact as part of a coherent story, the model comes to believe it more deeply and becomes less misaligned than when we instruct it to assert the false fact. Content filters and persona vectors cannot tell these two framings apart, even though they lead to different levels of misalignment. These results suggest a risk for model updates, where training a model that does not adopt the new fact as true can induce misalignment even when the data looks harmless.
arxiv.titleZh: 明知故犯：用违背模型自身信念的数据训练LLM会诱发失准
arxiv.summaryZh: 微调通常被认为只有在有害数据上才会引发广泛失准，但实际训练中显式有害数据很罕见。该工作在数学、常识、烹饪、体育等领域用模型自认为错误但内容无害的答案做微调，发现模型对答案的怀疑越强、失准越严重：数学任务中失准回答从4%升至60%以上，而通用能力几乎无损；微调后模型口头输出错误答案，但多选题概率仍偏向正确答案，说明失准源于这种内部不一致。在单条事实更新的知识编辑/持续学习设定中同样成立，且把虚假事实包装成连贯故事会让模型更深地接受它、失准反而更轻，内容过滤器与人设向量均无法区分这两种表述。这提示模型更新时，若模型未真正接纳新事实，即使数据看似无害也可能带来失准风险。
arxiv.reason: 涉及后训练微调与对齐失稳机制，实验扎实、结论有实践价值

arxiv.title: Beyond Accuracy: What Language-Subspace Interventions Capture, Remove, and Improve
arxiv.abstract: Language-subspace interventions aim to improve multilingual reasoning by suppressing language-related components in mid-layer activations. Using MATH and MGSM across four open-weight LLMs, we ask three questions: do estimated language subspaces capture translation-associated variation? Does projecting them out remove language information? And do they improve accuracy without compromising response language? For the first question, we build subspaces using the existing Mean-SVD construction and our DiffPCA. Both capture substantial translation-associated variation and show similar patterns across model depth. For the second, we project out each subspace and train linear probes to classify language from the projected activations. The probes still identify language almost perfectly, showing that neither subspace exhaustively captures language information. For the third, we evaluate several intervention configurations on Qwen2.5-7B, by varying subspace creation methods and intervention operators. We find that the intervention that most improves MGSM accuracy sacrifices response-language fidelity, with only one intervention improving joint accuracy--answers that are correct and in the target language--slightly, by 1.60 points. Interestingly, subtle changes in the prompt alone can reproduce the accuracy gains albeit with significant damage to language fidelity. We argue that causal interventions must be judged on more than accuracy, to fully account for language substitution trade-offs.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越准确率：语言子空间干预捕获、移除与改进了什么
arxiv.summaryZh: 语言子空间干预通过在中间层激活中抑制语言相关成分来提升多语言推理，但这类干预的实际作用缺乏系统检验。在MATH与MGSM上对四个开放权重模型，用Mean-SVD与自提出的DiffPCA构造子空间，两者都捕获了大量与翻译相关的变异，且沿模型深度的模式相似。将子空间投影剔除后，线性探针仍几乎完美识别语言，说明子空间并未穷尽语言信息；在Qwen2.5-7B上，最能提升MGSM准确率的干预同时牺牲了回答语言一致性，仅有一种配置使「答案正确且语言正确」的联合指标微升1.60分，而仅改动提示词即可复现准确率增益但严重损害语言保真度。结论是因果干预的评估不能只看准确率，须计入语言替换带来的权衡。
arxiv.reason: LLM内部激活干预与多语言推理分析，偏可解释性与评测方法，但为workshop短文

arxiv.title: De Rham cohomological architectures for PINNs and PDEs with topological holes
arxiv.abstract: We attempt to alleviate failure modes of classical physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) in scenarios of topological pathologies corresponding to punctures, holes, poles, and voids by introducing de Rham cohomological augmentations, or Hodge-de Rham PINNs. Vanilla PINNs often encounter pitfalls in hole-based settings due to discontinuous interfaces, nonzero closed path integration, path dependence, correspondence to exact forms via the exterior derivative, etc., therefore we absolve traditional failures via parameterizing a 1-form by the Hodge-Morrey-Friedrichs (HMF) decomposition for manifolds with boundary, drawing a connection to de Rham cohomology such as through the HMF isomorphism theorem. 1-forms can act as representations of scalar-valued PDE solutions through integral operator mappings. We propose performing a PINN-based loss on the parameterized 1-form through an associated PDE, which subsequently solves the potential-based PINN problem and moreover remedies the failures of vanilla PINNs via the Sobolev-regular operator under a Fréchet differentiation interconnection. The operator relationship often has a nontrivial closed-form and often requires integration or a case-by-case analysis, which we address thoroughly in our experiments. When an integrability condition is not met on our losses, we can equip exhaustion functions to train the networks. We demonstrate our methods on the Aharonov-Bohm effect, which, to our understanding, is largely nonexistent in PINN literature. We develop theoretical guarantees of our methods and demonstrate our pathological safeguards on a broad selection of topologically-adverse problems, including scenarios of inexact forms, and those of nontrivial harmonics and coexact terms.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向 PINN 与带拓扑孔洞 PDE 的 de Rham 上同调架构
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对经典 PINN 在带孔洞、极点、空腔等拓扑病态区域上因界面不连续、闭环积分非零与路径依赖而失效的问题，提出 Hodge-de Rham PINN：用 Hodge-Morrey-Friedrichs 分解在有边流形上参数化 1-形式，经积分算子映射表示标量 PDE 解，并在对应 PDE 上施加 PINN 损失，借助 Fréchet 微分下的 Sobolev 正则算子恢复势函数解；当损失不满足可积性条件时引入穷竭函数辅助训练。方法给出理论保证，在 Aharonov-Bohm 效应及非恰当形式、非平凡调和与余恰当项等病态算例上验证了失效规避效果。
arxiv.reason: PINN 与上同调的数值 PDE 工作，与 LLM 关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: The Geometry of Ignorance: Detecting Suppressed Knowledge in LLMs through Activation Fragmentation
arxiv.abstract: Evaluating whether a large language model (LLM) genuinely knows a concept remains a fundamental problem, since behavioral metrics can be fooled by suppression: a model that refuses to answer may still harbor recoverable knowledge. The framework measures the geometric coherence of \textit{anon-vectors}, the differences in hidden states between a concept-specific query and its anonymized paraphrase, and shows that genuine knowledge forms a tight, low-entropy cluster while ignorance forces geometric fragmentation. Across ten instruction-tuned LLMs from three model families, all fragmentation metrics reliably separate known from unknown concepts, and post-unlearning, fragmentation geometry correlates with adversarial recovery across four attack types and five unlearning algorithms, though the direction of that relationship is shown to depend on attack methodology. Furthermore, a layer-resolved analysis reveals that different adversarial mechanisms exploit this geometry at varying depths, with high attack-specific correlations that are invisible to behavioral evaluation. Together, these results constitute a single-phase, attack-free proxy for unlearning robustness that captures aspects of parametric knowledge inaccessible to output-level metrics. A reference implementation is available at https://github.com/AdarPeleg/geometry-of-ignorance
arxiv.titleZh: 无知的几何:通过激活碎片化检测 LLM 中被抑制的知识
arxiv.summaryZh: 行为指标会被「抑制」欺骗:模型拒答某个概念，不代表它不掌握该概念。方法用 anon-vector——概念特定问句与其匿名化改写之间的隐状态差——度量几何一致性，发现真知识形成紧致低熵簇，无知则导致几何碎片化。在三个模型家族共十个指令微调 LLM 上，碎片化指标稳定区分已知与未知概念;在遗忘(unlearning)场景中，其几何与四类攻击、五种遗忘算法下的对抗恢复相关，且相关方向依攻击方法而变;逐层分析显示不同攻击机制在不同深度利用该几何。由此提供一个单次前向、无需攻击的遗忘鲁棒性代理指标，可捕捉输出层指标无法触及的参数化知识状态。
arxiv.reason: 激活几何探测被抑制知识与遗忘鲁棒性，属机制分析类，方向擦边但扎实

arxiv.title: iGC: Antibody Optimization via Reinforcement Learning over a Learned Somatic Hypermutation Prior
arxiv.abstract: Antibody affinity maturation is a natural optimization process in which B cells acquire mutations through somatic hypermutation (SHM), undergo selection for improved antigen binding, and iteratively evolve toward higher affinity. Computationally modeling this process requires capturing both biologically plausible mutations and antigen-specific selection. However, existing mutation models do not directly optimize binding, while affinity optimization often neglects realistic mutation trajectories. We introduce iGC (in silico Germinal Centers), a two-stage reinforcement learning (RL) framework for antigen-specific antibody optimization. Stage 1 learns an SHM mutation prior from parent-child pairs in B-cell lineage trees and adapts it to a target affinity-maturation dataset. Stage 2 initializes an RL policy from this prior and optimizes antigen binding with Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization toward the frozen prior. To prevent reward exploitation, including repetitive high-reward substitutions and structurally tolerated framework mutations, we introduce a Reward-Tax Meta-Gradient objective. RewardNet smooths the affinity landscape, while TaxNet penalizes reward overexploitation, jointly defining a learned meta-reward for policy optimization. We evaluate iGC on mutation prediction, SHM consistency, affinity optimization, and mutation diversity. The mutation prior more than doubles the strongest baseline in mutation-site prediction. Following RL optimization, iGC maintains SHM sequence structure. It also achieves a strong exploration-exploitation balance, yielding competitive reward-diversity products across candidate-selection cutoffs. These results demonstrate that iGC integrates biologically plausible mutation generation with antigen-specific affinity selection, providing an in silico framework for iterative antibody affinity maturation.
arxiv.titleZh: iGC:基于学习所得体细胞超突变先验的强化学习抗体优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 抗体亲和力成熟需要在符合生物学规律的突变轨迹上针对抗原做定向选择，但现有突变模型不直接优化结合亲和力，而亲和力优化方法又常偏离真实的突变路径。iGC 采用两阶段强化学习框架:第一阶段从 B 细胞谱系树的亲子序列对中学习体细胞超突变先验，再适配到目标亲和力成熟数据集;第二阶段以该先验初始化 RL 策略，并用冻结先验上的 KL 正则约束优化抗原结合。为防止策略利用奖励漏洞(例如重复高分替换、在框架区做结构上可容忍的突变)，引入 Reward-Tax 元梯度目标:由 RewardNet 平滑亲和力景观，由 TaxNet 惩罚对奖励的过度利用，两者共同构成可学习的元奖励。在突变位点预测上，该先验的准确率超过最强基线一倍以上，优化后仍保持体细胞超突变的序列结构，并在不同候选筛选阈值下取得较优的奖励与多样性乘积。
arxiv.reason: 抗体亲和力优化属蛋白质/生物信息学方向，与关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Stabilizing On-Policy Targeted Guidance in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Naive on-policy RL is often bottlenecked by the capabilities of the base model --- insufficient coverage can result in an inability to learn from certain rewards. At the same time, rewards in modern post-training systems often come from rich textual sources, e.g. judge models with a rubric of criteria. Can we utilize such structures to provide a rich directional signal that enables improving on otherwise difficult to optimize rewards? In this work, we examine a framework we refer to as targeted guidance that learns from per-turn textual feedback via an on-policy self-distillation objective. Our focus is not only on directly improving hard-to-optimize behaviors, but on how to do so throughout the training process without degrading baseline RL performance. Over a range of settings across an agentic multi-turn software engineering environment, we find success by combining targeted self-distillation with a per-criteria RL reward, and by limiting feedback to turns where the policy specifically fails. We further examine the design choices that lead to stable entropy and reduce oscillatory behavior throughout training.
arxiv.titleZh: 稳定 Agentic RL 中的同策略定向引导
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对朴素同策略 RL 受基座模型能力限制、难以从某些奖励中学到有效行为的问题，利用 judge 模型按评分细则给出的逐轮文本反馈构造定向信号，通过同策略自蒸馏目标把引导注入训练，并配合分项标准的 RL 奖励、仅在被策略实际失败的轮次上提供反馈，从而在提升难优化行为的同时不损害基线 RL 表现。在多轮软件工程 agent 环境中验证了该组合的有效性，并分析了维持熵稳定、抑制训练震荡的设计选择。适用于以 rubric 奖励驱动的 Agentic RL 后训练。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 与同策略自蒸馏结合，直击后训练方向

arxiv.title: JHiMA-WebRL: A Joint Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal web agents have shown promising capabilities for interacting with websites through graphical user interfaces (GUIs), yet realistic web tasks often require long-horizon, multi-step planning that remains challenging for monolithic policies. Such agents must jointly infer high-level plans, navigate through intermediate states, track progress over extended interaction histories, and execute visually grounded actions. Although prior work has explored modular multi-agent systems with a separate planner, the planner is typically not updated jointly with the actor. We investigate whether explicitly separating and jointly training planning and execution provides a stronger inductive bias for long-horizon web navigation. We introduce JHiMA-WebRL, a joint hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for web agents that couples a task decomposer with an actor. To train the decomposer, we use a strong teacher model to construct structured subtask supervision from multimodal GUI trajectories, and use these annotations to fine-tune both the decomposer and the subtask-conditioned actor. We then extend Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to jointly optimize the decomposer and actor in the interactive WebArena environment through hierarchical rollout grouping and role-specific advantages. On WebArena-Lite-v2, JHiMA-WebRL-14B, consisting of a 7B actor and a 7B decomposer, achieves an average success rate of 37.2%, compared with 24% for a ScaleCUA-32B agent that we fine-tune with RL on the same training tasks and evaluate under the same protocol. Ablations show that jointly updating the decomposer during RL outperforms updating the actor alone. These results suggest that jointly learned role factorization with smaller models can be a competitive alternative to scaling monolithic agents for long-horizon web tasks.
arxiv.titleZh: JHiMA-WebRL:面向长程网页任务的联合分层多智能体强化学习框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对多模态网页Agent在长程任务中难以由单体策略同时完成高层规划、中间状态导航与视觉动作执行的问题，提出将任务分解器与actor显式分离并联合训练的分层框架。先用强教师模型从多模态GUI轨迹中构造结构化子任务监督，微调任务分解器与以子任务为条件的actor;再将GRPO扩展到WebArena交互环境，通过分层rollout分组与角色专属优势联合优化两个角色。由7B actor与7B分解器组成的JHiMA-WebRL-14B在WebArena-Lite-v2上取得37.2%平均成功率，高于同协议下经RL微调的ScaleCUA-32B的24%;消融显示联合更新分解器优于只更新actor。结果表明角色分解加联合学习的小模型组合可作为长程网页任务中扩大单体Agent规模的竞争性替代方案。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL与分层网页Agent,GRPO联合优化有方法分量

arxiv.title: NovoCRF: Globally Normalized De Novo Peptide Sequencing on a Prefix-Mass Lattice
arxiv.abstract: De novo peptide sequencing has moved from dynamic programming over hand-designed or generative scores to large transformers that learn the task end to end. We present NovoCRF, a conditional random field (CRF) whose states are prefix masses, so that its paths are exactly the peptides within +/-0.06 Da of the precursor mass. A small network scores each edge from physics-derived ion-match features and is trained with its scores globally normalized over all mass-feasible peptides. To our knowledge, NovoCRF is the first de novo method trained with exact normalization over all mass-feasible peptides. Our software has three modules, each with exactly one job: a precursor mass finder recovers the accurate precursor mass from MS1, the CRF finds the peptides that fit the precursor mass by exact k-best decoding, and two BiGRU rerankers add sequence context and internal-fragment evidence. The model has 310k parameters and trains in about 17 GPU-hours. On seven held-out data-dependent acquisition datasets published in 2026 (126,262 labeled spectra), NovoCRF's mean peptide recall is 42.4%, against 39.1% for Casanovo v5 with five beams, and its amino-acid recall 64.0% against 53.1%, at 1,746 spectra/s on 18 CPU threads, 55x Casanovo's throughput on a GPU. Split by fragment evidence, NovoCRF leads on labels with up to three peptide bonds without a b or y ion, and Casanovo only beyond. NovoCRF can also search modifications it was never trained on at their exact mass: it finds 32.1% of the hydroxyproline peptides of a lion bone sample.
arxiv.titleZh: NovoCRF：在前缀质量格上做全局归一化的从头肽段测序
arxiv.summaryZh: 从头肽段测序面临搜索空间巨大与训练目标不一致的问题：常规做法用动态规划或生成式模型对谱图逐位打分，却缺少对所有质量可行肽段的精确归一化。NovoCRF 把条件随机场的状态定义为前缀质量，使解码路径恰好落在前体质量±0.06 Da 内，并用由物理离子匹配特征导出的边分数在全质量可行肽段集合上做全局归一化训练；配套流程含 MS1 前体质量找回、CRF 精确 k-best 解码与两个 BiGRU 重排器，模型仅 310k 参数、约 17 GPU 小时训练。在七个 2026 年发布的 DDA 数据集（126,262 张标注谱图）上，平均肽段召回 42.4%（Casanovo v5 五束为 39.1%），氨基酸召回 64.0% 对 53.1%，18 线程 CPU 上达 1,746 谱/秒，约为 Casanovo GPU 吞吐的 55 倍，并能按精确质量搜索未训练过的修饰。
arxiv.reason: 面向蛋白质从头测序的生物信息学工作，落在低分方向

arxiv.title: Going Deeper With Memories
arxiv.abstract: Byte level language models avoid tokenizer dependence and provide universal coverage, but processing every byte at full resolution is expensive. We introduce DeepMem, a causal multiscale architecture that separates semantic compression from exact byte preservation. A learned invertible subband transform constructs a hierarchy of shorter sequences, while a lossless carrier and explicit detail sidebands preserve byte identity. Fast weight memory blocks operate along the encoder, with iterative shared state computation at the compressed bottleneck, while an attention based super resolution decoder restores byte resolution representations. DeepMem achieves stronger language modeling performance than a matched byte level Transformer on FineWeb-Edu and PG19, and obtains the best macro average performance across the evaluated FLORES languages. It also improves PIQA accuracy while remaining competitive on code modeling, multiple choice reasoning, and byte level corruption robustness. Bottleneck refinement requires approximately $7{,}600\times$ fewer counted FLOPs than equivalent full resolution reasoning, while maintaining competitive evaluation throughput.
arxiv.titleZh: 《深入记忆》
arxiv.summaryZh: 字节级语言模型逐字节全分辨率计算代价高昂。为此提出因果多尺度架构DeepMem，将语义压缩与字节精确保持分离：可学习可逆子带变换构造更短序列的层级，无损载波与显式细节边带保留字节身份；快速权重记忆块沿编码器运行，在压缩瓶颈处迭代共享状态计算，注意力超分辨率解码器恢复字节分辨率表示。在FineWeb-Edu与PG19上语言建模性能超过同等规模的字节级Transformer，在FLORES各语言上取得最佳宏平均，PIQA准确率提升，代码建模与多选推理保持竞争力；瓶颈精炼所需FLOPs比全分辨率推理少约7600倍，且吞吐相当。
arxiv.reason: 字节级多尺度新架构，记忆块与瓶颈精炼设计新颖，命中架构方向

arxiv.title: Logarithmic Regret for Alternating Mirror Descent
arxiv.abstract: Alternating online mirror descent (AltOMD) is a simple learning rule for zero-sum games, which improves upon simultaneous OMD numerically and theoretically. Previous work obtained $O(T^{1/3})$ and $O(T^{1/5})$ regret bounds for AltOMD, by leveraging modified-energy-function-based analyses. However, settling whether AltOMD achieves near-constant regret has remained an open question. In this paper we resolve the question of whether AltOMD achieves near-constant regret in the affirmative. In particular, we show an $O(log(T))$ regret bound on the sum of the players' external regrets for any two-player zero-sum bilinear game with compact convex strategy sets, under mild regularity assumptions on the regularizers. We verify that our assumptions hold for the negative entropy regularizer, thereby obtaining logarithmic regret for the alternating multiplicative weights updates algorithm. The regret bound also yields an $O(log(T)/T)$ duality gap bound for the averaged strategies.
arxiv.titleZh: 交替镜像下降的对数遗憾界
arxiv.summaryZh: 交替在线镜像下降（AltOMD）是零和博弈的简单学习规则，此前只能得到O(T^{1/3})与O(T^{1/5})的遗憾界，能否达到近常数遗憾一直悬而未决。该工作证明：在策略集为紧凸集、正则项满足温和正则性假设时，任意双人零和双线性博弈的外部遗憾之和为O(log T)，并验证负熵正则满足假设，从而给出交替乘性权重更新的对数遗憾。该界还导出平均策略的O(log T/T)对偶间隙。
arxiv.reason: 纯在线学习与博弈理论，与LLM无关，不属关注方向

arxiv.title: Shrinkage prior for implicit generative models
arxiv.abstract: Implicit generative models based on deep neural networks have revolutionized many scientific fields, from weather research to language generation. They successfully model complex random objects arising in real-world problems. In this work, we propose a sample-efficient training mechanism for these models. Our approach leverages regularized inference with shrinkage priors and generalized Bayes. In the large $p$ (parameter dimension) and small $n$ (sample size) setting, sparsity-inducing priors have been successfully used for linear regression when $p \gg n$. However, their application to implicit generative models remains challenging due to the intractability of the likelihood function. To address this, we adapt a scoring rule posterior based on a strictly proper scoring rule, following the generalized Bayes framework. We then propose a block SGMCMC within Gibbs sampling mechanism. This enables efficient exploration of high-dimensional parameter spaces by identifying a sparse representation of neural implicit generative models. We demonstrate the performance of our proposed method through experiments on $p \gg n$ linear regression and an application of neural generative models.
arxiv.titleZh: 隐式生成模型的收缩先验
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对隐式生成模型在参数维度远大于样本量时训练样本效率低的问题，引入收缩先验与广义贝叶斯下的正则化推断，并用基于严格适当评分规则的评分规则后验绕开不可处理的似然。方法在 Gibbs 采样中嵌入分块 SGMCMC，以稀疏表示高效探索高维参数空间，从而提升神经隐式生成模型的样本效率。在 p≫n 线性回归与神经生成模型实验中验证了有效性，适用于小样本、高维参数的生成建模场景。
arxiv.reason: 贝叶斯稀疏先验用于隐式生成模型，与LLM/Agent主线关联弱

arxiv.title: ARLoop: Fully-Open Pre-trained Looped Transformers with Attention Residuals
arxiv.abstract: Looped transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared set of transformer layers, offering a parameter-efficient way to scale computation. However, standard residual connections aggregate information across recurrent depth into a single stream, providing limited control over which intermediate representations from preceding layers should be reused. In this paper, we introduce ARLoop, a looped transformer architecture based on attention residuals, where the input of each layer is selectively aggregated through attention over model depth. Distinct from standard transformers, we find that looped transformers do not require access to the full residual history: sliding-window depth attention matches or outperforms full-history attention at larger recurrent depths. Across controlled experiments with multiple parameter scales (140M and 370M) and recurrent depths (R = 1 to 5), ARLoop consistently outperforms prior residual designs for looped transformers. More importantly, we further scale ARLoop to 0.6B and 1.2B parameters under a realistic LLM pretraining recipe, demonstrating that the gains transfer to realistic pretraining, with particularly strong improvements on math and coding tasks. Our 1.2B model, pretrained on only 0.5T tokens with three recurrences, outperforms Huginn-3.5B (the only fully-open looped LLM as of our release date) across all evaluated tasks and is competitive with similar-sized non-looped models such as Qwen3.5-2B despite being trained on substantially less data.
arxiv.titleZh: ARLoop：带注意力残差的完全开放预训练循环 Transformer
arxiv.summaryZh: 循环 Transformer 通过反复应用共享层来增加有效深度，但标准残差把跨循环深度的信息压成单一流，难以选择复用哪些中间表示。ARLoop 改用注意力残差，让每层输入通过沿模型深度方向的注意力选择性聚合，并发现滑动窗口深度注意力在较大循环深度下即可匹配甚至超过全历史注意力。在 140M 与 370M 参数、R=1 到 5 的受控实验中稳定优于既有残差设计；进一步按真实预训练配方扩展到 0.6B/1.2B，数学与代码任务提升显著，1.2B 模型仅用 0.5T token、三次循环即在全部评测任务上超过完全开放的 Huginn-3.5B，并与 Qwen3.5-2B 相当。
arxiv.reason: 循环 Transformer 架构创新加开源预训练模型，直接命中架构与预训练方向

arxiv.title: Post-Inference Model Chaining: A Problem Statement and a Model-based Bootstrap for Training End-to-End Digital Twins
arxiv.abstract: End-to-end digital twins can be constructed by fitting separate stage models and connecting them after inference. We investigate the Frequentist prediction properties of a commonly used Monte Carlo simulation scheme that forwards complete predictive draws through such a chain when measured stage outputs contain independent normal errors, but the latent stage means are deterministic. Analytical two-stage examples show persistent asymptotic interval and coverage inflation and, with quadratic propagation, mean bias dependent on the parameters to be estimated. Simulations of four- and eight-stage linear-quadratic univariate chains with 7, 15 or 30 training runs demonstrate pronounced input-dependent distortions. A diagnostic using error-free latent training predictors shows that the effect is mainly not attributable to errors in variables, but to the MCSim approach even showing underestimation of coverage. We propose a model-based bootstrap: an initial chain forwards fitted means, bootstrap chains are refitted on fixed-center bootstrap data while forwarding their mean prediction, and a target-stage future error enters a studentized prediction root. Across the investigated scenarios, relative mean bias is substantially reduced, and coverage is closer to the nominal 90%. At sample size 30, the eight-stage bootstrap has mean width ratios of 1.16-1.42 relative to the known-parameter normal reference, compared with 4.11-4.97 for observed-to-observed MCSim. These results support improved endpoint prediction in the tested setting. Further investigations of the bootstrap scheme in the supplement for a bivariate 6-stage process show similar satisfactory results.
arxiv.titleZh: 推理后模型链式连接：问题陈述与基于模型的 bootstrap 用于训练端到端数字孪生
arxiv.summaryZh: 端到端数字孪生常由分别拟合各阶段模型、推理后再串联得到。当阶段实测输出含独立正态误差、潜在阶段均值确定时，常用的蒙特卡洛模拟（MCSim）把完整预测抽样沿链前传，会造成持续性的区间与覆盖率膨胀，二次传播下还引入依赖待估参数的均值偏差；两阶段解析示例与四、八阶段线性—二次链仿真显示失真随输入显著变化，诊断表明主因是 MCSim 方案本身而非变量误差。提出的基于模型 bootstrap 令初始链前传拟合均值、bootstrap 链在固定中心重抽样数据上重拟合并前传均值预测，再把目标阶段未来误差纳入 studentized 预测根。样本量 30 时八阶段链平均宽度比 1.16–1.42（对照已知参数正态参考），观测对观测 MCSim 为 4.11–4.97，覆盖率更接近名义 90%。
arxiv.reason: 经典统计推断与 bootstrap 方法，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Fairness Metrics based on the AUC in Clinical Predictive AI
arxiv.abstract: Fairness evaluation of clinical prediction models for binary outcomes often involves fairness metrics that compare the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC, or c-statistic) across subgroups. However, the AUC has been shown to be a non-collapsible metric, meaning that its subgroup specific and overall values are not directly comparable as often implicitly assumed. This raises important questions about how existing AUC-based fairness metrics should be used and interpreted. We examine eight AUC-based fairness metrics proposed in the literature, including: within-group AUC parity; cross-group AUC (xAUC) parity; gap-to-overall AUC; equity-scaled AUC; minimum-based metrics; $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$; $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$; and $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$ or $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$ parity. We characterise their estimands, relate them to the decomposition of overall AUC (into within- and cross-group components), and critically appraise them. We then illustrate their behaviour using simulations based on the EuroSCORE II, a clinical prediction model for in-hospital mortality. We recommend reporting an AUC matrix, containing the overall AUC and all within- and cross-group AUC components, alongside population characteristics. When fairness metrics are needed, we recommend reporting the within-group AUC parity, with cross-group AUC parity providing supplementary information but requiring caution due to its potential conflict with calibration. Metrics involving $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$ and $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$ have merit, summarising within- and cross-group AUCs into single values, but their interpretation is non-trivial, and they should be used with caution. Gap-to-overall AUC, equity-scaled AUC, and minimum-based metrics compare quantities that should not be compared and it is unclear how to operationalise them, making them not fit for purpose and generally not recommended.
arxiv.titleZh: 临床预测 AI 中基于 AUC 的公平性指标
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对二分类临床预测模型的公平性评估常比较各子群的 AUC，但 AUC 不可折叠(non-collapsible)，子群值与整体值并不能像通常假设的那样直接比较，导致现有基于 AUC 的公平性指标含义含糊。工作系统梳理了文献中的八种 AUC 公平性指标(组内 AUC 一致性、跨组 AUC 一致性、gap-to-overall AUC、equity-scaled AUC、基于最小值的指标及三种 xAUC 变体)，刻画其估计目标，并将其与整体 AUC 分解为组内与跨组分量联系起来加以批判性评述，再用 EuroSCORE II(院内死亡预测)的模拟展示各指标行为。建议报告含整体 AUC 与全部组内、跨组 AUC 分量的 AUC 矩阵并附人群特征;确需公平性指标时推荐组内 AUC 一致性，跨组 AUC 一致性仅作补充且因可能与校准冲突需谨慎，而 gap-to-overall、equity-scaled 与基于最小值的指标比较了不应比较的量，不建议使用。
arxiv.reason: 临床预测模型的 AUC 公平性统计方法，与 LLM 关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Fusing Earth observation embeddings and spaceborne terrain with meteorological forcing for flood peak depth prediction from high-water marks
arxiv.abstract: Flood peak depth on normally dry land governs damage and risk to life, but is observed only sparsely, by post-event high-water mark (HWM) surveys, and depth derived from satellite flood extent is produced after the event and inherits the vertical error of the digital elevation model (DEM) it is computed from. Deep-learning flood models have in turn been trained on hydrodynamic simulations rather than on observed depths. We ask whether flood peak depth can be learned from field observations and predicted before the peak from spaceborne terrain, geospatial foundation-model embeddings and antecedent meteorological forcing. We assembled 5689 USGS HWM surveys from 39 events (2011-2025) in 24 U.S. states and Puerto Rico, assigned each a peak time from nearby sensors, paired each with a rain-free window at the same site, and linked them to Copernicus GLO-30 terrain, AlphaEarth embeddings and 144 h of hourly forcing masked to the lead time. A cross-modal fusion network trained on these observations predicts depth at the surveyed marks with a mean absolute error of 0.39 m 6 h ahead of the peak. Supervision by surveyed depth corrects the DEM error implicitly: differencing the measured peak water level with the same DEM gives 0.93 m at the same marks, 2.4 times larger, although it uses the measured water level and the model does not. Forcing accounts for 77% of the attributed reduction in depth error; terrain and the embeddings are statistically equivalent to each other and contribute the remaining 23%. On eleven held-out events the model still separates flooded from rain-free conditions but no longer resolves depth at the marks (R2 = 0.03), so the skill reported here is confined to the events and regions sampled. Field-surveyed depths can thus supervise flood depth prediction and correct terrain error that extent-based estimation cannot, while transfer to unseen storms remains the open problem.
arxiv.titleZh: 融合地球观测嵌入与星载地形及气象强迫，由高水位标记预测洪峰水深
arxiv.summaryZh: 洪水洪峰水深目前只能靠灾后高水位标记(HWM)稀疏观测，卫星洪泛范围反演的水深又受DEM垂直误差影响。该工作汇集美国24州及波多黎各39场事件的5689条USGS HWM记录，为每个点位匹配峰值时刻、无雨窗口与144小时逐时气象强迫，并接入Copernicus GLO-30地形和AlphaEarth地理空间基础模型嵌入，训练跨模态融合网络预测标记处水深。模型在峰值前6小时的平均绝对误差为0.39 m，而直接用同一DEM由实测水位反推的误差为0.93 m，约为其2.4倍;误差归因显示气象强迫贡献77%，地形与嵌入各占剩余23%。在11场留出事件上模型仍能区分洪水与无雨条件，但水深回归失效(R²=0.03)，跨事件泛化仍是未解问题。
arxiv.reason: 洪水水深预测属垂直行业应用，仅借地理基础模型嵌入，与LLM主线交集有限

arxiv.title: Privacy for Free in Efficient Agnostic Halfspace Learning
arxiv.abstract: We provide the first computationally efficient, differentially private algorithms for agnostically learning halfspaces. In particular, we study three different settings of agnostic learning: improper learning under Gaussian and log-concave marginals; proper learning under Gaussian marginals; and semi-agnostic learning under Gaussian marginals. In all three aforementioned settings, the added cost in the sample complexity due to privacy matches the respective non-private sample complexity, implying that we get privacy for free.
arxiv.titleZh: 高效 agnostic 半空间学习中的免费隐私
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 agnostic 半空间学习，给出首个计算高效且满足差分隐私的算法，覆盖三种设定:高斯与对数凹边缘分布下的 improper 学习、高斯边缘下的 proper 学习，以及高斯边缘下的 semi-agnostic 学习。核心结果是隐私所额外付出的样本复杂度与对应非隐私样本复杂度同阶，即隐私不带来额外样本代价。该结果属于学习理论与隐私算法的交叉方向，为差分隐私下的一般概念类学习提供了紧的样本复杂度刻画。
arxiv.reason: 纯学习理论与差分隐私，与 LLM 关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Multi-Objective Generative Optimization via Expected Hypervolume Fine-Tuning
arxiv.abstract: Scientific discovery requires plausible designs spanning useful trade-offs among competing properties: a molecule with strong binding affinity, for example, may be difficult to synthesize. Pretrained generative models, e.g., flow and diffusion generators, provide a foundation for proposing such designs, but steering them toward high-quality, complementary trade-offs remains challenging. Inference-time search incurs high per-sample costs, while fine-tuning typically relies on fixed per-candidate rewards that do not capture how designs complement one another. We introduce Hypervolume Fine-Tuning (HVFT), which adapts a single pretrained generator to maximize the expected hypervolume of its samples while controlling departure from the pretrained distribution. Expected hypervolume jointly rewards candidate quality and collective trade-off coverage. Nonetheless, we show that it cannot be expressed as the expectation of a fixed per-candidate reward and therefore cannot be optimized directly with standard techniques. A key observation of this work is that its first variation corresponds to the expected marginal hypervolume contribution of a candidate, which yields a tractable adaptive reward via an unbiased estimator based on model samples. HVFT uses this reward to decompose the objective into a sequence of KL-proximal scalar-reward subproblems. We establish concavity, relative smoothness, and convergence guarantees for the resulting distributional procedure. Across therapeutic-peptide and molecular design tasks spanning discrete diffusion and continuous flow-matching models, HVFT achieves state-of-the-art expected hypervolume and trade-off coverage.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于期望超体积微调的多目标生成优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对预训练生成模型（流匹配、扩散）在多目标设计中难以被引导向高质量且互补的权衡解的问题：推理时搜索单样本成本高，常规微调又只依赖固定的单候选奖励、无法刻画候选间的互补性。HVFT 以样本的期望超体积为目标，同时约束与预训练分布的偏离；作者证明该目标无法写成固定奖励的期望，但其一阶变分恰为候选的期望边际超体积贡献，据此用模型采样的无偏估计构造自适应奖励，将目标分解为一系列 KL 近端标量奖励子问题，并给出凹性、相对光滑性与收敛性保证。在治疗性肽与分子设计任务（离散扩散与连续流匹配模型）上取得最优的期望超体积与权衡覆盖。
arxiv.reason: 分子与肽设计的扩散生成模型微调，落在低分方向

arxiv.title: Empirical Bayes Flow Matching for Continuous Cryo-EM Heterogeneity
arxiv.abstract: We address the problem of learning generative priors over high-dimensional latent variables from indirect, noisy observations, with a focus on continuous heterogeneity in cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM). In this setting, 3D atomic structures $x \in \mathbb{R}^{3N_a}$ are never directly observed and must be inferred from 2D projection images $y$ generated by a complex, non-linear forward operator. We propose Empirical Bayes Flow Matching (EB-FM), a method that learns a flow matching prior $p_θ(x)$ directly from observations using a Monte Carlo stochastic approximation Expectation-Maximization framework. EB-FM alternates between an E-step that performs approximate posterior sampling from $p_θ(x \mid y)$ via guided flow-based generation while maintaining persistent latent estimates through stochastic approximation, and an M-step that updates the flow model using these stabilized latent variables as training targets. This approach eliminates the need for pretraining on clean data and naturally accommodates non-linear forward models. We validate our method on controlled inverse problems using two-moons and MNIST data, and demonstrate its effectiveness on simulated cryo-EM data with known poses, showing that EB-FM can recover continuous distributions of protein conformations directly in atomic-coordinate space.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://daiyral.github.io/Empirical-Bayes-Flow-Matching-for-Continuous-Cryo-EM-Heterogeneity/
arxiv.titleZh: 面向连续冷冻电镜异质性的经验贝叶斯流匹配
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对高维隐变量只能通过间接、带噪观测推断的问题（以冷冻电镜的连续构象异质性为场景），提出经验贝叶斯流匹配（EB-FM），不依赖干净数据预训练即可直接从 2D 投影图像学习原子坐标空间上的流匹配先验。方法以蒙特卡洛随机近似的 EM 框架交替迭代：E 步通过引导式流生成从后验采样，并用随机近似维护持久的隐变量估计；M 步以这些稳定化后的隐变量为目标更新流模型，从而适配非线性前向算子。在 two-moons、MNIST 受控逆问题以及已知姿态的模拟冷冻电镜数据上验证，可在原子坐标空间直接恢复蛋白质构象的连续分布。
arxiv.reason: 冷冻电镜蛋白构象重建，属生物信息与生成建模，与 LLM 无关

arxiv.title: Ensembles of Random Partition-Based Models under Covariate Shift
arxiv.abstract: Distribution shifts, including covariate shifts, are ubiquitous in real-world applications of machine learning. Empirical evidence suggests that, across a variety of models with and without downstream adaptation, ensembles tend to be more robust to covariate shift than single models. We extend the theory of covariate shift severity from single models to ensembles, providing theoretical justification for the empirical trends. We introduce new discrepancy measures of covariate shift severity to control the risk of partition-based kernel estimators. We then show that with sufficient ensemble size, these models can achieve minimax-optimal risk convergence rates under covariate shift. Our results suggest that modelers can expect to need larger ensemble sizes for more severe covariate shifts.
arxiv.titleZh: 协变量偏移下随机划分模型的集成
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对协变量偏移下单一模型风险难以控制的问题，将协变量偏移严重性的理论从单模型推广到集成模型，提出新的差异度量来约束基于划分的核估计器风险，并证明在集成规模足够大时可达极小极大最优收敛速率；结果还表明偏移越严重所需的集成规模越大，为集成方法在分布偏移场景下的可靠性提供了理论依据。
arxiv.reason: 纯协变量偏移统计学习理论，与 LLM 关注方向无关

arxiv.title: Stepsize modulation for cross entropy from local quadratic optimization
arxiv.abstract: Two methods are presented that perturb a given learning rate schedule in stochastic gradient descent with cross entropy loss. Both methods use an extra forward pass to estimate various derivatives of the minibatch loss. The first method selects a value $η$ by linearising the softmax values and minimizing the squared error $\tfrac 1 2 ||y - q - ηq'||_F^2$, where $q$ is the matrix representing the softmax values of the minibatch and $y$ is the matrix with one-hot encodings of the labels. The second method considers a quadratic Taylor approximation of the minibatch loss under the outer approximation of the Hessian. Thus, it minimizes $L(0) + ηL'(0) + \tfrac 1 2 η^2 L''(0)$. Here, the derivatives $L'$ and $L''$ are computed from the derivatives of the logits (using the outer approximation of the Hessian of the loss). We observe that both methods give very similar values of $η$. Finally, these estimated $η$ are used to slightly increase or decrease the learning rate of an existing schedule. The method is evaluated on Cifar10 and Cifar100 datasets for training Resnets, where they decrease the loss faster than the schedule that is perturbed and increase monotonicity. For Cifar10 it also leads to a small improvement of test accuracy, but in Cifar100 test accuracy remains the same.
arxiv.titleZh: 交叉熵的步长调制：基于局部二次优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对随机梯度下降训练交叉熵模型时的学习率调度，给出两种利用额外前向传播估计 minibatch 损失导数、对现有步长进行微调的方法：一种线性化 softmax 并最小化 1/2||y−q−ηq'||_F^2，另一种在 Hessian 外近似下最小化损失的二次 Taylor 展开 L(0)+ηL'(0)+1/2η^2L''(0)，两者估计出的 η 很接近。在 CIFAR10 与 CIFAR100 上训练 ResNet 时，该方法比被扰动的调度损失下降更快、单调性更好；CIFAR10 测试精度略有提升，CIFAR100 保持不变。
arxiv.reason: 经典 SGD 步长微调，与 LLM 无关，仅沾优化边

arxiv.title: Provably Learning Mixtures of Linear Experts
arxiv.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are widely deployed in modern machine learning. However, few convergence guarantees exist for gradient-based training of MoEs: the objective is nonconvex, and even simple mixtures trap first-order methods in spurious local optima. We analyze a canonical gated mixture featuring linear experts and a gate induced by Gaussian clusters in the input space, and give, to our knowledge, the first global convergence guarantee for jointly training the gate and the experts of such a model by gradient EM on its likelihood. Given a logarithmic overparameterization relative to the true number of experts $m$, gradient EM converges from randomly initialized gates and least-squares-initialized experts to any prescribed accuracy in polynomially many iterations, under a separation condition on the gate centers. Our analysis establishes a gradient-dominance inequality for the coupled dynamics by decoupling the loss into per-cluster subproblems. Empirical results validate the predicted $m\log m$ phase transition and suggest that the least-squares warm start required by our analysis is not needed in practice: randomly initialized experts perform nearly as well. We also find that leaving the mixing weights unconstrained concentrates routing onto the true number of experts, whereas load-balancing penalties spread it, so that the fitted model can be pruned to a fraction of its width without loss of accuracy.
arxiv.titleZh: 可证明地学习线性专家混合模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对MoE梯度训练缺乏收敛保证、简单混合易陷入伪局部最优的问题，分析由高斯簇输入诱导门控与线性专家构成的门控混合模型，证明联合训练门控和专家的梯度EM可全局收敛：在门控中心分离条件下，相对真实专家数m仅需对数级过参数化，从随机门控与最小二乘专家初始化出发，多项式次迭代内达到任意精度；关键是将损失解耦为逐簇子问题并建立梯度支配不等式。实验验证m log m相变，最小二乘热启动在实际中非必需，随机初始化专家表现接近；不加约束的混合权重使路由集中到真实专家数，负载均衡惩罚则使其分散，模型可剪枝到部分宽度而不损失精度。
arxiv.reason: MoE梯度EM全局收敛证明，命中架构方向但设定简化

arxiv.title: AgentAM: An AI Agent for Spatter- and Defect-Aware Process Optimization in Laser Powder Bed Fusion
arxiv.abstract: Predictive models for laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) are rarely used on the shop floor because querying them requires programming and model-specific knowledge. We present AgentAM, a large language model (LLM) agent that gives process engineers natural-language access to CFD-trained surrogates of spatter and melt pool geometry for SS316L through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Polynomial surrogates trained on 279 single-track simulations predict melt pool dimensions ($R^2 \geq 0.95$) and spatter volume ($R^2 = 0.83$ on test data) at any power-velocity point in the trained range, and geometric criteria assign each point a geometry-derived defect regime (keyhole, lack of fusion, balling or stable) that matches the regime obtained from the simulated geometry in 93.4% of tracks under cross-validation. The agent selects and parameterizes tools for prediction, process-window scans and constrained optimization. Minimum-spatter optima often sat within 10 $μ$m of the lack-of-fusion boundary; a margin-aware optimizer moved them away from all thresholds and raised the estimated probability of remaining classified Good from 0.94 to 1.00 under an assumed 2% process drift, and from 0.72 to 0.91 when jointly sampled cross-validated geometry residuals were added. About 40-50 well-spread simulations sufficed to reproduce the defect map. To evaluate the agent layer, we introduce a 145-prompt benchmark scored against direct tool calls, plus eight prompts (40 runs) on margin-aware requests. Over the 725 runs of the main benchmark the agent passed the intended inputs in 98.5% of parsing prompts, reported the scored spatter values and defect classes faithfully and met every stated constraint in the 65 feasible optimization runs, within a median 1.0% of the brute-force optimum.
arxiv.titleZh: AgentAM：面向激光粉末床熔融中飞溅与缺陷感知工艺优化的 AI 智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）的预测模型需要编程与模型专门知识、难以在车间直接使用的问题，构建 LLM 智能体 AgentAM，经 MCP 把基于 CFD 训练的多项式代理模型（熔池尺寸 R²≥0.95、飞溅体积 R²=0.83）封装为自然语言可调用的工具，并用几何判据划分匙孔、未熔合、球化与稳定四类缺陷区间（交叉验证下与仿真几何一致率 93.4%）。智能体负责工具选择与参数化，覆盖预测、工艺窗口扫描与带约束优化，余量感知优化器在 2% 工艺漂移假设下将保持 Good 的概率从 0.94 提升到 1.00。另提出 145 条提示的智能体评测基准，725 次运行中解析类提示输入正确率 98.5%，65 次可行优化的结果距暴力最优中位 1.0%。
arxiv.reason: LLM 智能体用于增材制造工艺优化，属垂直行业应用，仅擦边 Agent 工具调用

arxiv.title: Learning Behaviorally Relevant Dynamics in Multimodal Neural Recordings
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal neural data can enable a more complete understanding of brain dynamics underlying behavior. Modalities such as spiking activity, local field potentials (LFPs), and behavior capture diverse spatiotemporal aspects of brain processes, yet prior neural-behavioral models that separate sources of variability rely on a single neural modality. By leveraging these complementary strengths, multimodal neural fusion can provide a unified, rich representation of brain-behavior processes and address the limitations of single-modality analyses. Here we develop BREM-NET, a nonlinear multimodal dynamical model that integrates behavior with multiple neural modalities having distinct statistical characteristics and temporal resolutions. BREM-NET performs multimodal neural fusion during inference while separating behaviorally relevant and residual neural dynamics via a structured learning framework. In a public multimodal non-human primate dataset with simultaneous spiking and local field potential recordings during a 2D reaching task, BREM-NET separates these two types of dynamics and learns them more accurately, as reflected in better behavior decoding, better neural prediction, and stronger latent alignment with behavior, and it retains these capabilities when neural modalities are asynchronous or suffer dropouts, which are major challenges in real-world recordings. This framework provides a new tool for studying behaviorally relevant neural computations across spatiotemporal scales of brain activity.
arxiv.titleZh: 在多模态神经记录中学习与行为相关的动力学
arxiv.summaryZh: 同时记录脉冲活动、局部场电位（LFP）与行为的多模态神经数据，能够刻画不同时空尺度上的脑活动;但已有的神经-行为模型大多只依赖单一神经模态，因此难以分离行为相关成分与残余成分。BREM-NET 是一个非线性多模态动力学模型，通过结构化学习框架，在推断阶段完成多模态神经融合，并把与行为相关的动力学与残余动力学分离开。在同时记录脉冲与 LFP 的公共非人灵长类二维伸臂数据集上，该模型在行为解码、神经预测以及与行为的潜变量对齐三项指标上均优于对比方法，并且在模态异步或存在缺失（dropout）时仍保持这些能力。该框架为跨时空尺度研究行为相关的神经计算提供了工具。
arxiv.reason: 计算神经科学的多模态动力学建模，与 LLM 关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: When Self-Verification Hurts: Calibrated Answer Repair for Financial Question Answering
arxiv.abstract: Financial question answering can fail even when a model extracts a plausible number from the supplied evidence: the answer may attach it to the wrong entity, period, unit, or accounting concept. Asking the model to verify and revise its draft can help, but open-ended revision may alter content that was already correct or inspect the wrong relation and reinforce the original error. We formulate repair as a decision that balances the information it may recover against the correct content it may damage. Based on this trade-off, we introduce Calibrated Answer Repair (CAR), which first estimates whether a draft is likely to benefit from repair, then selects a targeted check, localizes the relevant evidence or draft span, and limits the permitted edit. Across FinRank, Fin-RATE, and FinQA with three open-weight models, CAR outperforms generic verification in all dataset-model settings. At the system level, it recovers 14.6% of initially missed answer requirements while damaging 2.1% of initially correct ones. Its post-draft token cost is over 30 percent lower than the iterative revision alternatives. Ablations on two dataset-model settings show that evidence localization and bounded editing are the main contributors to CAR's gains.
arxiv.titleZh: 当自我验证反而有害时：金融问答中的校准答案修复
arxiv.summaryZh: 金融问答的答案即使抽取到看似合理的数值，也可能被错误地绑定到实体、期间、单位或会计口径上。该工作把「验证—修订」建模为一项决策，在可能恢复的信息与可能破坏的正确内容之间权衡，并提出 Calibrated Answer Repair（CAR）：先估计草稿是否值得修复，再选择有针对性的检查，定位相关证据或草稿片段，并限制允许的编辑范围。在 FinRank、Fin-RATE 与 FinQA 上搭配三个开放权重模型，CAR 在所有数据集与模型的组合设置上均优于通用验证，挽回 14.6% 初始遗漏的答案要求，仅破坏 2.1% 原本正确的答案，草稿后的 token 开销比迭代修订方案低 30% 以上。消融实验显示，证据定位与有界编辑是主要增益来源。
arxiv.reason: 金融问答的验证—修复框架，偏垂直应用，方法可借鉴但分量有限

arxiv.title: Basin2Vec: Learning Basin-Centric Embeddings for Scalable Hydrological Modeling
arxiv.abstract: Reliable streamflow prediction across time and in ungauged basins requires representations that capture hydrologically relevant basin characteristics. Existing methods rely on either fixed handcrafted attributes or general-purpose Earth observation embeddings not tailored to basin structure. We introduce \textbf{Basin2Vec}, a self-supervised framework that learns compact basin representations from hydroclimatic and physiographic data without observed streamflow. Basin2Vec organizes representation learning around basin scale and relationships across space and time. Across multiple forecasting architectures, it consistently outperforms predefined attributes and general-purpose geospatial embeddings in temporal generalization and zero-shot spatial transfer. Basin2Vec provides average relative gains of up to 8.3% temporally and achieves 3.5x the median predictive performance of the strongest baselines on unseen basins. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of basin-centric pretraining for transferable hydrologic prediction. Code is available at https://github.com/Muhammad-Talha-MT/basin2vec
arxiv.titleZh: Basin2Vec：面向可扩展水文建模的流域中心嵌入学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 跨时空与无观测流域的径流预测，需要能刻画水文相关流域特征的表征，而现有做法要么用固定的人工属性，要么用未针对流域结构定制的通用地球观测嵌入。Basin2Vec 是一个自监督框架，在不使用实测径流的情况下从水文气候与地形地貌数据中学习紧凑的流域表征，并把表征学习的组织方式围绕流域尺度以及跨空间、跨时间的关系展开。在多种预报架构上，它在时间泛化和零样本空间迁移上稳定优于预定义属性与通用地理空间嵌入，时间维度平均相对提升最高 8.3%，在未见流域上的中位预测性能达到最强基线的 3.5 倍。结果说明流域中心预训练可为可迁移的水文预测提供有效支撑。
arxiv.reason: 水文领域的自监督表征学习，与 LLM 关注方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: Macrocanonical Generator Networks: Data-Efficient Neural Surrogates for Amortized Physics Simulation
arxiv.abstract: Many scientific simulations are computationally expensive, limiting their use in simulation-based inference, uncertainty quantification, and decision making. We introduce macrocanonical generator networks, a framework for learning fast, data-efficient neural surrogates for amortized simulation of stationary physical processes by matching multiscale statistics of a target process. Inspired by microcanonical maximum-entropy synthesis, which matches feature statistics per sample by inner-loop optimization, our approach instead trains a neural generator to satisfy the same constraints in expectation, preserving physically realistic sample-to-sample fluctuations. We prove that gradient-descent training induces preconditioned gradient-descent dynamics in sample space that inherit the symmetry-preservation properties of the microcanonical gradient descent of Bruna and Mallat, amortizing its per-sample inner-loop optimization into a single training run after which every sample is generated in one forward pass. We further show that residual generator parameterizations initialized near the identity, trained with a small learning rate, preserve entropy locally during early optimization and mitigate mode collapse. Experiments on cosmology and fluid simulations show that macrocanonical generators recover realistic samples from extremely small training sets, in some cases a single training example, while generating new realizations more than $10^6$ times faster per sample than the reference simulator and more than $10^3$ times faster than microcanonical gradient descent. The trained generators can be reused for downstream pretraining, including simulation-based inference, providing a data-efficient route to multi-fidelity scientific machine learning workflows.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages total (inc. appendices), 4 figures
arxiv.titleZh: 宏正则生成网络：面向摊销物理模拟的数据高效神经代理模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 科学模拟的计算开销限制了其在基于模拟的推断、不确定性量化和决策中的使用。宏正则生成网络通过匹配目标过程的多尺度统计量，把原本需要对每个样本做内层优化的微正则最大熵合成，摊销为一次训练:训练后的生成器单次前向即可采样，并保留样本间物理真实的涨落。理论分析表明，梯度下降训练会在样本空间诱导出预条件梯度下降动力学，继承 Bruna 与 Mallat 微正则梯度下降的对称性保持性质;接近恒等映射的残差参数化配合小学习率可在早期优化中局部保持熵，缓解模式崩塌。在宇宙学与流体模拟实验中，该方法能从极小训练集(个别情形仅一个样本)恢复真实感样本，单样本生成速度比参考模拟器快10^6倍以上，比微正则梯度下降快10^3倍以上，训练好的生成器还可复用于下游预训练与基于模拟的推断。
arxiv.reason: 物理模拟神经代理，属科学计算交叉，与 LLM 关注方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: Catalyzing Interactive HTML Generation Capabilities via High-Fidelity Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Generating HTML from natural-language specifications is an important application of code large language models (LLMs). Despite producing renderable pages, current models often fail to ensure functionality and visual quality during actual interaction. Existing methods typically target task-specific webpage supervision, leaving demanding interactive artifact optimization underexplored. Using mini-games as a challenging testbed, we expose limitations in interaction experience, reward signal, and credit assignment fidelity that are obscured by shallow webpage interactions. We introduce WebCatalyst, a browser-interaction reinforcement learning framework with three complementary components: a game-level GUI assessor for sustained interaction and evaluation, Visual Anchor for mitigating VLM reward hacking, and Action-Trace Credit for grounding token-level credit assignment in runtime execution traces. Trained on fewer than 1K requests, predominantly for games, WebCatalyst raises the Cookie-Bench Mini Games score from 68.8 to 75.3 and also the WebGen-Bench accuracy from 48.8 to 56.9 on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, outperforming Claude Opus 4.7 in average rank across evaluated metrics. Further analysis shows that Visual Anchor prevents aesthetic degradation, while runtime-grounded credit assignment accelerates functional improvement. Together, our results show that improving feedback fidelity is the key to substantially advancing interactive HTML generation.
arxiv.titleZh: 以高保真强化学习催化交互式HTML生成能力
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有代码LLM虽能生成可渲染的网页，但在真实交互中的功能与视觉质量欠佳，而针对交互式产物的优化研究不足。以迷你游戏为测试床，提出浏览器交互强化学习框架 WebCatalyst，包含持续交互与评估的游戏级GUI评估器、缓解VLM奖励攻击的Visual Anchor，以及将token级信用分配锚定到运行时执行轨迹的Action-Trace Credit。仅用不足1K条请求训练，在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上将 Cookie-Bench Mini Games 从68.8提升至75.3、WebGen-Bench准确率从48.8提升至56.9，平均排名超过 Claude Opus 4.7。结果表明反馈保真度是推进交互式HTML生成的关键，适用于代码智能体与可验证奖励设计。
