arxiv.title: Creating Power Flexibility in Datacenters via Query Routing
arxiv.abstract: The growing energy requirements of large language model inference highlight the need for datacenters to support safe grid operation by providing power demand flexibility, while maintaining service for interactive workloads. This work investigates query routing as a mechanism to enable such capability by dynamically allocating queries across different language model instances without deferring requests. We develop a general analytical framework that connects query arrival rates and sequence length distributions to token iteration time, request residence time, serving capacity, and power consumption of model instances. Leveraging this framework, we characterize the feasible query routing allocations and the corresponding power demand flexibilities, enabling the selection of routing strategies to achieve desired power consumption behavior. We validate our framework across four GPU platforms on language models ranging from 1B to 70B parameters, obtaining 2.8% mean absolute percentage error in estimating achievable power flexibility. We evaluate our approach on a real trace-driven simulation of a 10,000 H100 GPUs datacenter, exhibiting flexibility up to 16% of total power consumption, with 90% of the desired power reduction achieved within approximately 10 seconds. These results establish query routing as an effective mechanism for datacenter power demand flexibility and demonstrate the broader applicability of our proposed framework to datacenter level planning and orchestration.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过查询路由为数据中心创造电力灵活性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对LLM推理能耗攀升、数据中心需向电网提供需求侧灵活性的问题，提出以查询路由实现功率调节：在不延迟请求的前提下，将查询动态分配到不同模型实例上。建立解析框架，把查询到达率与序列长度分布映射到token迭代时间、请求驻留时间、服务容量与实例功耗，据此刻画可行的路由分配集合及其对应的功率灵活性区间，并据此选择路由策略。在1B至70B模型、四类GPU平台上验证，功率灵活性估计的平均绝对百分比误差为2.8%；在10000张H100的数据中心真实trace驱动仿真中，可调功率达总功耗的16%，约10秒内完成90%的目标降功率。该机制可用于数据中心级规划与编排。
arxiv.reason: 推理路由实现功率调节，属推理服务系统但偏电网需求侧

arxiv.title: GM League Arena: An Interactive Long-Horizon Task Benchmark Based on Professional Sports League Management
arxiv.abstract: Long-horizon decision-making under sustained competition requires large language models (LLMs) to balance immediate investment with future resource needs. However, local success in multi-step interactions can not adequately capture cumulative decision effects or demonstrate long-term goal achievement under resource constraints and sustained competition. To address this gap, we introduce GM Bench, a benchmark for managing professional sports teams across seasons under resource constraints and competition among teams. We build the environment simulators for four sports and add financial constraints, player demands, and market mechanisms to establish a unified task across sports. Diverse rosters of comparable strength are constructed from real-world player data, and each LLM is evaluated as a team general manager to assess its long-term management capabilities. We evaluate competitive performance, cash reserves, and cross-season improvement across four sports. Over five NBA seasons, Claude Opus 5.5 ranks first among 29 LLMs, while GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol combine strong performance with larger cash reserves.
arxiv.titleZh: GM League Arena：基于职业体育联盟管理的交互式长程任务基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 长程决策要求模型在持续竞争中平衡当下投入与未来资源需求，而多步交互的局部成功率无法反映累积决策效果与长期目标达成。GM Bench 为四种职业体育项目搭建环境模拟器，加入财务约束、球员诉求与市场机制，形成跨项目统一任务；用真实球员数据构造实力相当的多套阵容，让 LLM 以球队总经理身份参赛，并按竞技成绩、现金储备与跨赛季提升进行评估。在 29 个 LLM 参与的五个 NBA 赛季中，Claude Opus 5.5 排名第一，GPT-6 Astra 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 在保持较强战绩的同时拥有更多现金储备。该基准面向长程规划、资源约束下的取舍与多赛季自我改进等 Agent 能力评测。
arxiv.reason: 长程决策 Agent 基准，命中评测与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Beyond Foundation Models: PFN Priors Improve Tabular Hyperparameter Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Synthetic priors have so far served one purpose: pretraining tabular foundation models. We ask whether the same priors can improve conventional tabular models, which are trained from scratch on each dataset. We propose PriorTune, a method that meta-tunes hyperparameter configurations on synthetic tasks alone. Offline, for a given model, we fit a pool of configurations on datasets sampled from a published PFN prior and greedily select the subset with the highest winrate over the random baseline. Online, a new dataset fits only the selected configurations, so the gain comes at no extra cost. Empirically, we observe that scaling both the number of configurations and synthetic datasets has an equal scaling effect on the performance of the final subset of configurations, which we also explain theoretically. On the full BeyondArena benchmark, LightGBM with TabPrep features with our configurations ranks above TabPFN-3 and RealMLP, while being much more efficient at inference. Overall, our results establish existing PFN priors as a scalable source of meta-training data for hyperparameter selection for non-foundational tabular models.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越基础模型：PFN 先验改进表格超参数优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 合成先验此前只用于预训练表格基础模型，能否也用来改进需逐数据集从零训练的常规表格模型？PriorTune 在离线阶段仅用 PFN 先验采样的合成数据集拟合一批超参数配置，再按对随机基线的胜率贪心筛选子集；在线阶段新数据集只拟合被选中的配置，因此不增加额外成本。实验显示配置数量与合成数据集数量对最终子集的性能有等效的 scaling 效应，并给出理论解释。在完整 BeyondArena 基准上，配 TabPrep 特征的 LightGBM 排名超过 TabPFN-3 与 RealMLP，且推理效率更高。
arxiv.reason: 表格超参与合成先验元学习，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Meta$^2$: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents
arxiv.abstract: Harness optimization improves long-horizon agents by refining the prompts, tools, memory, and hooks around a frozen model. Offline methods can learn from completed trajectories, but deploy one shared harness that may overfit training tasks and cannot react to evidence revealed during a new run. Online evolution can adapt before, during, or after one run through an evolver, but may have to reason about every intervention from scratch or rely on verifier feedback that is usually unavailable at test time. We introduce Meta$^2$, which moves offline optimization one level up: rather than optimizing a shared harness, it learns reusable knowledge for harness evolution and applies it within each task online. Offline, Meta$^2$ learns a textual Meta-Skill $M$ by contrasting training rollouts of the same task agent under three configurations: without an evolver, with an evolver guided by the current version of $M$, and with an evolver given privileged verifier information available only in training. Contrasts in trajectories and outcomes are aggregated across tasks to refine $M$ into reusable guidance on when and how to evolve, when to leave the harness unchanged, and which interventions to avoid. Online, an evolver combines the frozen $M$ with emerging trajectory evidence to decide whether to KEEP the harness unchanged or EVOLVE it through a task-local edit. Each edit applies to the rest of the same run without resetting its environment or progress. Thus, evolution guidance transfers across tasks while harness edits remain task-local, and held-out verifier feedback is never available to the evolver. On two long-horizon benchmarks, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and DeepSWE 1.1, Meta$^2$ achieves the highest performance among evaluated methods with GPT-5.6-Terra, reaching 81.00% and 44.44%, respectively. Ablations support the value of contrastive evolution guidance and keeping online harness edits task-local.
arxiv.titleZh: Meta$^2$:为长程智能体的在线 harness 进化预计算可复用知识
arxiv.summaryZh: 长程智能体的 harness 优化存在两难:离线方法学到的共享 harness 易过拟合并无法响应运行中新出现的证据，在线进化则需每次从零推理且测试时缺少 verifier 反馈。Meta$^2$ 把离线优化提升一层，通过对比同一任务智能体在「无 evolver」「由当前 Meta-Skill M 引导的 evolver」「带训练期特权 verifier 信息的 evolver」三种配置下的 rollout，聚合轨迹与结果差异，提炼出可复用的文本化 Meta-Skill，指导何时进化、如何进化、何时保持不动以及应避免哪些干预。在线阶段，evolver 结合冻结的 M 与新出现的轨迹证据，在 KEEP 与任务局部 EVOLVE 之间决策，编辑仅作用于本次运行剩余部分而不重置环境与进度。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 与 DeepSWE 1.1 上分别达到 81.00% 与 44.44%，为所评估方法中最高，消融验证了对比式进化指导与任务局部编辑的价值。
arxiv.reason: Agent harness 在线进化，方法新颖且长程基准结果扎实

arxiv.title: From Opinions to Commitments: Unstable Assignments and Silent Choices in AI-Mediated Proposals
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to turn citizens' opinions into collective proposals. These proposals can make assignments: who should act, what must be done, how much one should spend and by when. However, if the assignments change when the same opinions are processed again, publishing a single proposal can hide alternatives that participants never get to see. We examined this issue in four LLM mediators (three open-weight and one commercial) using opinions from DeliberationBank and Polis. For each task, a mediator drafted a proposal from thirty opinions five times, varying either the random seed or the order of the opinions. In 17% of five-run sets from the open-weight mediators and 20% from the commercial one, some runs contained assignments while others did not. Reordering the opinions changed the assignments almost as often as replacing them with opinions from different citizens. Three human annotators confirmed that the detected differences between runs were real, although the LLM judge overstated how often they occurred. Substantial variation remained under four safeguards: temperature zero, a commercial mediator, draft selection, and draft merging. The mediator's objective also shaped representation: prompts seeking agreement covered minority positions much less often than prompts asking to describe differences. A single proposal can therefore obscure choices in both the assignments it proposes and the views it excludes. We propose audits that make alternative assignments visible and disclose the objective behind each proposal.
arxiv.titleZh: 从意见到承诺：AI介导提案中不稳定的分配与沉默的选择
arxiv.summaryZh: 同一批公民意见交给LLM中介反复生成集体提案时，任务分配（谁做、做什么、花多少）会随随机种子或意见顺序变化，只发布单一提案会掩盖参与者未见的备选方案。在DeliberationBank与Polis意见上，三个开源模型与一个商用模型各对30条意见起草5次：开源模型的17%、商用模型的20%的五次运行集合中出现部分有分配、部分无分配；仅重排顺序的影响几乎等同于更换意见来源。三名标注者确认差异真实，LLM评判则高估其频率；温度归零、商用模型、草稿筛选与合并四种防护下变异依然存在。要求“寻求共识”的提示比“描述分歧”更少覆盖少数立场，作者据此提出让备选分配可见并披露提案目标的审计。
arxiv.reason: LLM审议类垂直应用，含稳定性审计但方向偏

arxiv.title: PAC Learning with Multiple Correct Answers
arxiv.abstract: We study PAC learning when each example comes with a set of at most $\ell$ correct labels and a prediction is correct if it belongs to this set. Training may reveal the full set, only whether a proposed label is correct (bandit feedback), or one correct label chosen by a demonstrator (emonstrations). Our main finding is that demonstrations can be much harder than full sets, and even than bandit feedback, both in which classes can be learned and in how many examples are needed. For finite label spaces, a generalized Natarajan dimension characterizes learnability from full sets and from bandit feedback, in both the realizable and the agnostic setting. From demonstrations, however, a class is realizably learnable if and only if the intersections of at most $\ell+1$ of its hypotheses are learnable from full sets. Already with three labels, this condition can fail for a class learnable from a single full-set example or even a single bandit answer. When the condition holds, we show that $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-\ell})$ demonstrations suffice, and the exponent $\ell$ cannot be improved in general, even for classes learnable from $\widetilde O(1/\varepsilon)$ full sets or bandit answers. For countable label spaces and $\ell \geq 2$, our packed dimension, which asks for many disjoint groups of at most $\ell+1$ hypotheses with no common label, characterizes full-set learnability, and demonstrations still reduce to intersections. Agnostic learning from demonstrations, already for finite label spaces, is not determined by the dimensions of the intersection class that characterize realizable learning. Finally, we show that the uniform bound $\ell$ on the number of correct labels is essential. Without this bound, it is impossible to characterize learnability by any dimension determined by finite subclasses.
arxiv.titleZh: 多正确标签下的 PAC 学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究每个样本对应至多 ℓ 个正确标签的 PAC 学习，并区分三种监督形式:给出完整标签集、仅给出候选标签是否正确(bandit 反馈)、由示范者给出一个正确标签(示范)。核心结论是示范监督可能严格难于完整标签集乃至 bandit 反馈，既体现在可学习类别的范围上，也体现在样本复杂度上:有限标签空间下，广义 Natarajan 维刻画完整集与 bandit 反馈的可学习性，而示范监督可实现学习当且仅当任意 ℓ+1 个假设的交集可从完整集学习，且所需示范数约为 ε^{-ℓ} 量级、指数不可改进。还为可数标签空间引入 packed 维刻画完整集学习，并指出示范监督的 agnostic 学习无法由交集类的维数决定。
arxiv.reason: 纯学习理论，与 LLM 或后训练无交集

arxiv.title: Do Ray-Traced Cities Make a Better Channel Prior for an Unseen Site? A Pre-Registered Study in Simulation, and a Test on Measured Channels that Reverses It
arxiv.abstract: Channel estimators at a newly deployed base station usually start from 3GPP stochastic channel models, which describe no particular street. We ask whether a channel prior pooled from many ray-traced cities serves an unseen site better than the 3GPP CDL models, and whether learned estimators make the difference. With Sionna RT on 14 city scenes, LMMSE estimation from covariance priors, leave-one-city-out evaluation, and pass/fail bars written down before each main experiment, we find in simulation that the pooled prior sits about 0.6 dB from a site-trained estimator with no site measurements, about what CDL reaches after 50 measurements. Learned models added little: at most 0.65 dB in estimation, and in channel prediction a simple classical method beat CNN predictors by 1.8-12 dB from 2 ms ahead. On measured channels from the DICHASUS outdoor dataset (1.272 GHz, three 2x8 arrays on one building) the result reversed: the pooled ray-traced prior was 3.2-4.1 dB worse than CDL. The simulated channels were too clean; with users at the real distances, even a scattering level tuned from 50 site measurements left the prior about 2 dB behind CDL. A pre-registered follow-on on two more measured environments found the generic CDL prior 2.1-4.7 dB from a site-trained one: no further in a factory hall than on the street, furthest in a small lab room. Finally, a hallway model calibrated to measurements by differentiable ray tracing reproduced delay spread, but as a prior in an unmeasured part of the hallway it was 4.5 dB worse than CDL on the full array. All measured results come from one sounder.
arxiv.titleZh: 光线追踪城市能为未见站点提供更好的信道先验吗？一项预注册的仿真研究，以及在实测信道上得到反转结论的检验
arxiv.summaryZh: 新部署基站做信道估计，常以3GPP随机信道模型为先验，而这类模型并不描述任何具体街道；这里检验从多个光线追踪城市汇聚出的信道先验，是否比3GPP CDL 对未见站点更有效，以及学习型估计器能否带来差别。方法上用 Sionna RT 构建14个城市场景，以 LMMSE 从协方差先验估计，做留一城市交叉验证，并在每个主实验前预先写下通过/失败阈值。仿真显示：汇聚先验与按站点自训练的估计器相差约 0.6 dB，相当于 CDL 用50次测量后达到的水平；学习模型增益有限（估计最多 0.65 dB），在信道预测上，一种简单的经典方法在提前 2 ms 时反而比 CNN 预测器好 1.8–12 dB。但在 DICHASUS 室外实测信道（1.272 GHz，同一建筑上三块 2x8 阵列）上，结论反转为光线追踪先验比 CDL 差 3.2–4.1 dB，原因是仿真信道过于干净；在另两个实测环境中，通用 CDL 先验距站点自训练估计器 2.1–4.7 dB。结论对以仿真数据构建信道先验的研究具有警示意义，但所有实测结果均来自同一台探测器。
arxiv.reason: 无线信道建模与光线追踪仿真，与LLM方向无交集

arxiv.title: The Right Source Is Not Enough: Understanding History Interference in Speech-LLM Memory
arxiv.abstract: Speech large language models retain audio history to support multi-turn conversations. Yet remembering an event does not ensure that its information is used only when relevant. We investigate why irrelevant historical audio changes answers even when the queried event remains represented. Controlled experiments on MOSS-Audio and MiMo-Audio show that historical values direct errors toward specific competing answers, beyond a generic effect of context length. Causal interventions distinguish two paths. In open-ended question answering, most history-value errors disappear when subsequent computation cannot directly access the irrelevant source. In multiple-choice answering, many errors persist: early historical influence is carried by question-candidate states even after direct source access is blocked. Low-dimensional interventions further separate source-role information from answer-value information. Their effects peak at different depths, and changing the source-role signal does not eliminate the causal influence of competing values. On naturally occurring errors, strengthening the queried role and counteracting the historical value each improve answers; their joint intervention gives the greatest recovery. These findings support a failure of downstream evidence use beyond source identification alone: source-role information can influence a decision without exclusively controlling which historical values affect it. Reliable conversational memory therefore requires not only retention and retrieval, but also control over how retained information enters answer computation.
arxiv.titleZh: 找对来源还不够：理解语音LLM记忆中的历史干扰
arxiv.summaryZh: 多轮语音对话中，即使被查询的事件仍在表征里，无关的历史音频也会改变答案。在MOSS-Audio与MiMo-Audio上开展控制实验与因果干预，发现历史取值会把错误导向特定的竞争答案，且开放式问答与选择题走不同路径：前者在阻断后续计算对无关来源的直接访问后大多消失，后者的早期影响已由问题—候选状态携带。低维干预进一步分离来源角色信息与答案取值信息，二者作用峰值深度不同，改动来源角色信号并不能消除竞争取值的因果影响。同时强化被查询角色并抵消历史取值可取得最大恢复幅度，说明可靠对话记忆不仅需要保留与检索，还需控制被保留信息如何进入答案计算。
arxiv.reason: 语音LLM记忆干扰的因果机制分析，方法扎实但偏模态特化

arxiv.title: Towards an Optimal Control Foundation of Early Exits - Turnpikes and ResNets
arxiv.abstract: The feed-forward propagation through neural networks is crucial for training and inference. To trade off efficiency and accuracy, it has been proposed to consider intermediate outputs of hidden states as data-dependent regularization during training and, ultimately, as early-exits during inference. In this work, we analyze the joint optimization of loss functions computed for the output layer and intermediate layers using optimal control theory. We prove that ResNets trained in this joint fashion exhibit the so-called turnpike phenomenon, this implies that the number of layers required to reach a prescribed loss level is bounded from above independently of the overall network depth. This induces a similarity property across the internal representations of early-exiting networks of varying depths. We connect the turnpike to the overthinking phenomenon, and provide theoretical insights into the success of early-exit criteria derived from softmax probabilities, specifically entropy and max-probability. In a range of experiments, we demonstrate the existence and effect of turnpikes and the resulting similarity in the early-exit performance for ResNets of varying depths.
arxiv.titleZh: 迈向早退的最优控制基础——turnpike现象与ResNet
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对早退网络在训练中联合优化输出层与中间层损失、推理时按需截断的做法，该工作用最优控制理论分析其联合优化性质。证明此类ResNet呈现turnpike现象：达到指定损失所需的层数存在与总深度无关的上界，并由此导致不同深度早退网络的内部表示具有相似性。进一步将该现象与overthinking关联，从理论上解释基于softmax概率的熵与最大概率早退准则为何有效，并在多组实验中验证turnpike的存在及其对早退性能的影响。
arxiv.reason: 早退与overthinking相关，但聚焦ResNet的最优控制理论，非LLM核心
